settings.title: What You Can Do with RJ Nexus
settings.subtitle: From visuals to code, RJ Nexus gives you a full creative suite powered by the latest multi-model AI — all in one place.

tabs.content_text: Turn your imagination into high-resolution art with a single prompt. No design skills required.
From debugging to full-stack generation, let AI handle the heavy lifting.
Create fully responsive landing pages with intelligent layout suggestions.

settings.title: Built for modern teams. Backed by cutting-edge AI.
settings.subtitle: RJ Nexus combines powerful AI models with a unified creative workspace — built for speed, clarity, and control.

features.feature_text: No more juggling tools. RJ Nexus unifies content, design, code, and video.
ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini — RJ Nexus picks the smartest engine for every task.
Every feature is prompt-optimized, giving you control without overwhelm.
From solo to teams, RJ Nexus delivers fast outputs — even under heavy loads.
Your content and code stay private. We never store sensitive data.
RJ Nexus improves weekly with better prompts, UI, and models — for free.

settings.title: From idea to output — in just three simple steps.
settings.subtitle: RJ Nexus streamlines your creative workflow. No complex settings, just results.

steps.step_text: Choose the type of content you want to create: a tagline, description, image, video idea, and more.
Enter keywords, context, or any starting idea. Upload images or videos to guide the result.
RJ Nexus returns multiple outputs. Choose your favorite, refine it, or keep exploring more options.

faqs.question: What can I use RJ Nexus for?
faqs.answer: You can generate taglines, short descriptions, ideas for visuals, social posts, and more in seconds.

faqs.question: Is RJ Nexus free to use?
faqs.answer: RJ Nexus offers a free tier with limited generations. Paid plans unlock more features and outputs.

faqs.question: Can I use RJ Nexus for commercial projects?
faqs.answer: Yes — all generated content can be used for both personal and commercial purposes.

faqs.question: How accurate are the outputs?
faqs.answer: Results are context-aware and high quality, but we recommend reviewing and refining for best use.

faqs.question: What if I don't like the result?
faqs.answer: You can regenerate as many times as needed, or edit outputs directly to suit your needs.

faqs.question: Do you offer support?
faqs.answer: Yes, our support team is available 24/7 to help you with any issues or questions you might have.

content:
Welcome to RJ CMS! This is your first blog post. Edit or delete it, then start writing.

What is RJ CMS?

RJ CMS is a modern self-hosted CMS built on Laravel 12, featuring RJBuilder — a drag-and-drop visual page builder.

Getting Started

Visit the admin panel to create new posts, pages, menus, and more. You can switch any post or page to RJBuilder mode to design it visually.

Happy building!

title: Getting Started with RJBuilder
content:
RJBuilder is the visual page builder included with RJ CMS. It provides a modern drag-and-drop interface for designing pages, headers, footers, and popups.

Key Features

  • Drag-and-drop blocks
  • Responsive breakpoints (Desktop / Tablet / Mobile)
  • Custom CSS and animations
  • Dynamic tags for content
  • AI assistant integration

How to Use

Open any post or page in edit mode, select "RJBuilder" as the edit mode, and click "Open Builder". You can then start adding blocks and customizing styles.
excerpt: Learn how to design beautiful pages with RJBuilder.
